header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ! إِنْ لَوْ تَدُومُونَ عَلَي مَا تَكُونُونَ عِنْدِي وَفِي الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ عَلَي فُرُشِكُمْ وَفِي طُرُقِكُمْ وَلكِنْ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ! سَاعَةً وَسَاعَةً ثَلَاثَ مِرَارٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل دوام الذكر ....رقم: ٦٩٦٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “By the One in whose hand my life is! If this state of mind that you have when you are in front of me were to remain with you, and if you were immersed in the Dhikr of Allah at all times, the angels would begin to shake hands (Musafahah) with you on your beds and on the paths you walk; however, O Hanzalah! this state comes only at certain times.” Hazrat Hanzalah Usaidi (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this three times.

blocks.text: Explanation:- That is, a person does not remain in one and the same state at all times; conditions keep changing according to circumstances.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَيْسَ يَتَحَسَّرُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ عَلَي شَيْءٍ إِلَّاعَلَي سَاعَةٍ مَرَّتْ بِهِمْ لَمْ يَذْكُرُو اللهَ فِيهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير والبيهقي في شعب الايمان وهو حديث حسن الجامع الصغير:٢ /٤٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “The people of Jannah will not feel regret about anything except the time that passed in the world without doing the Dhikr of Allah.” Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَدُّوا حَقَّ الْمَجَالِسِ: اُذْكُرُوا اللهَ كَثِيرًا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه الطبراني في الكبير وهو حديث حسن الجامع الصغير:١ /٥٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Fulfil the duty owed to gatherings; among the duties owed to gatherings
